holder-quote: The Ogre Chief stared. Pryde smiled archly.
effect-quote: She raised a hand as the Ogre Chief swore at her and swung. The Ogres of his clan saw her raise a hand and block the hammer a third time. And their morale broke. Beshard threw his javelin as the Ogre Chief stared at Pryde.
Pryde’s back began to straighten, and the reservoir of ego she had spent in battle returned.

holder-quote: She began walking forwards. Lyonette saw Erin raising her fist. Pryde saw it, and smiled.
effect-quote: She began walking forwards too. They were on a collision course. And the clash of auras was about to get physical. But Pryde was supremely confident in her defensive Skill. And Lyonette, looking between them, wondered what she could do. If she threw her power behind Erin—but she could barely push Pryde off her!

holder-quote: Pryde pulled her arm up out of the water with a grunt.
effect-quote: its sharp teeth weren’t even dimpling her flesh

holder-quote: Lady Pryde and House Ulta had advanced.
effect-quote: She swung a hammer, snapping the Hag Queen’s knee and producing blackened bones.
